nodes.label: MathJax SVG rendering
nodes.rationale: Bundled NewCM and formula-local SVG references support self-contained formulas; unsupported font/loading paths and optional speech fail explicitly.

nodes.label: Output processors
nodes.rationale: Image and PDF processors require a browser; HTML processing sets requiresPage false and avoids browser launch. Custom processors save only when outputFilename is explicit.

nodes.label: Conversion plugins
nodes.rationale: Ordered lifecycle hooks, extension injection and per-call Marked extensions customize conversion without changing mdimg source.

nodes.label: Preview site deployment
nodes.rationale: Typecheck and build the static site before deploying site/dist to GitHub Pages; cancel superseded runs.

nodes.label: Markdown rendering sample
nodes.rationale: Local images, complete prose, multilingual tables, code, formulas and diagrams give themes meaningful content across their available width.
nodes.source_location: Marked, Tables, Code and Structured Notes, LaTex, Mermaid

nodes.label: Consumer test execution policy
nodes.rationale: Consumer tests require explicit full-suite authorization; ordinary testing uses pnpm run test.

nodes.label: Packed consumer verification
nodes.rationale: An isolated production-only installation of the npm tarball verifies API, CLI, public types and offline rendering on current Node and Node 22.12.0 separately from default tests.

nodes.label: Complete extension suppression
nodes.rationale: Suppressing a named extension or plugin disables both injection and its owning plugin's parsing extensions, preventing parsing with absent resources.

nodes.label: Shared rendering readiness
nodes.rationale: Image and PDF output wait for libraries, typesetting, diagrams, fonts and images; exported HTML uses the same initialization and reports failures including a 30-second timeout.

nodes.label: Template DOM contract
nodes.rationale: The mdimg-body wrapper contains markdown-body, providing insertion and screenshot boundaries.

nodes.label: Chromium preview verification
nodes.rationale: Built-site Chromium verification checks actual image dimensions and diagram pixels plus debounce, sanitation, themes, recovery and keyboard access. Other engines need separate verification and DOM export need not match Puppeteer pixels.

nodes.label: Commit-pinned template resources
nodes.rationale: Only committed CSS/HTML at GITHUB_SHA or local HEAD are available remotely; compiled CSS must be committed before deployment. External runtime versions come from the root lockfile and require CORS.

nodes.label: Complete article image export
nodes.rationale: Capture all of mdimg-body at pixel ratio 1, verify MIME and decoded dimensions, preserve PNG/WebP transparency and reject canvas or memory overflow instead of truncating.

nodes.label: Sanitized iframe rendering
nodes.rationale: Same-origin iframes isolate article styles and extension state; DOMPurify removes active content and each update creates a fresh iframe so stale results cannot enable export.
